GESTALT.EnableGestaltHint: Treat this character as a gestalt: effective level, proficiency bonus, and hit points follow the "Original Class" above instead of the sum of all classes.
GESTALT.CombinedAsiHint: Only relevant if Enable Gestalt is checked. Allows this character to take Ability Score Improvements from every class independently (normal multiclassing) without a redundancy warning.
GESTALT.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Name: Enable Gestalt Sheets
GESTALT.Settings.ModuleEnabled.Hint: Master switch for this world. When off, no actor is affected even if gestalt is enabled on their sheet.
GESTALT.Settings.LimitSkills.Name: Limit Skill Choices
GESTALT.Settings.LimitSkills.Hint: For gestalt actors, warn if they've chosen more class-granted skill proficiencies than their most generous single class allows (e.g. Rogue's 4 vs Bard's 3), instead of silently allowing skills from every class.
GESTALT.LevelUpReminder: Gestalt: don't forget your other classes - {classes}
GESTALT.LevelExceedsBase: Gestalt: {classes} is now higher level than your base class, {base}
GESTALT.AsiRedundant: Gestalt: {name}'s {secondary} just reached an Ability Score Improvement, but base class {base} already has one at this point. Check "Use Combined Class ASIs" if you want to allow it.
GESTALT.SkillsOverCap: Gestalt: {name} has chosen {taken} class skill proficiencies, but their schedule only allows {cap}. Consider removing one.
